Carved Acoustic Chamber

The internal acoustic chamber design took almost as much time to complete by Blon as the new CNT driver's tuning. The inside chamber of BL05 was designed with an acoustic canal that precisely replicates the sound characteristics that the human ear perceives in an orchestra hall. The result of our labors can be completely appreciated, with an extraordinarily broad soundstage that resonates with the diaphragm's natural overtones, thanks to our painstaking manual placement of the driver at the exact location within each earphone.
